sm: Demolition of the current Nissan Stadium in Nashville will begin in March on the east side, with the west side expected down by the end of August, and the full teardown should take about a year. Before that, seats, collectibles and memorabilia will be offered for sale or auction in the coming weeks, and the building should be cleared by the end of January. The last events will be the Music City Bowl and the final Titans home game in January.
